user.title: Episode hybrid amplifier
user.description: Address, control port and login of the amplifier (the same user name and password as its web page). The setup logs in and reads the volume before saving, so a wrong port or login is caught here.

data.username: Amplifier user name (from its web page login)
data.password: Amplifier password (from its web page login)
data.mode: Command format (auto tries hex text, then raw bytes)
data.name: Name

error.cannot_connect: The amplifier did not answer on that address and port.
error.invalid_auth: The amplifier did not accept the user name and password. Use the same login as the amplifier's web page.

abort.already_configured: This amplifier is already set up.
